item.description:

Why: Theoretically describes mechanisms for altermagnetism, a core topic of interest for the user.

Tags: #theory #altermagnetism #sublatticecurrent

Abstract: Sublattice currents are a feasible route to odd-parity altermagnetism, where nonrelativistic collinear spin splitting occurs in the bands as an odd function of momentum.
